values.user_request: Customer reports an electric shock while using wireless headphones from order O0035 and explicitly requests escalation as a serious safety issue and help resolving it.
values.facts_found: User U008 verified using registered email; order O0035 belongs to U008. Affected item I0035: Wireless headphones, electronics, item value ₹2,499. Order delivered 2026-09-13 at 12:00 IST; today is 2026-09-15, within the 7-day electronics return window. Shipping fee ₹49; payment method UPI. Evidence photo is uploaded (confirmed with check_evidence; photo contents not assessed). No refunds in the last 90 days and no prior refunds on this order; qualifying count 0. Potential defective-item refund would be ₹2,548 including shipping to original UPI payment method, but no return or refund has been proposed, confirmed, or executed. Customer reports electric shock during use; injury details are not known. No further customer information was required before safety handoff.
values.rule_triggered: G2 and G6: reported electrical hazard requires immediate human escalation. G3: relevant order details, evidence status, and refund history gathered for handoff.
values.what_user_was_told: Apologized and acknowledged a serious safety issue. Advised the customer to stop using the headphones, not charge or test them again, and seek urgent medical care if injured or unwell after the shock. Said this needs immediate human review and asked once for the affected order and verification details, which the customer supplied. No refund or resolution timing was promised.
